article_title: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level B; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why Poundland entered administration after rescue talks failed, threatening jobs and stores
How Poundland opened 600 new stores before Christmas
Why a German firm successfully bought Poundland
How Poundland workers received higher wages
tasks.correct_answer: Why Poundland entered administration after rescue talks failed, threatening jobs and stores
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה כיצד כישלון עסקת הצלה הוביל להליכי חדלות פירעון וסיכן משרות וחנויות.

tasks.prompt: What will happen to Poundland's shops during the administration process for now?
options: They will all close immediately
They will remain open and continue trading
They will become government offices
They will sell only online
tasks.correct_answer: They will remain open and continue trading
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החנויות ומרכזי ההפצה יישארו פתוחים וימשיכו לפעול בשלב זה.

tasks.prompt: What did Barry Williams say Gordon Brothers removed on 27 October?
options: All store signs and uniforms
The company's Christmas advertising
Borrowing facilities and access to bank accounts
Every offer made by potential buyers
tasks.correct_answer: Borrowing facilities and access to bank accounts
tasks.explanation_hebrew: וויליאמס אמר שהבעלים הסירו מסגרות אשראי וגישה לחשבונות הבנק.

tasks.prompt: What does “going concern” mean in the discussion of Poundland?
options: A company able to continue operating as a business
A shop that sells only discounted goods
A temporary committee of MPs
A company whose assets have already been destroyed
tasks.correct_answer: A company able to continue operating as a business
tasks.explanation_hebrew: going concern הוא עסק שמסוגל להמשיך לפעול באופן שוטף.

tasks.prompt: Why might administration still offer some hope for Poundland?
options: It automatically cancels all debts and protects every job
It lets potential buyers consider purchasing the whole business or parts of it
It guarantees Gordon Brothers will return its loans
It prevents rival retailers from buying stores
tasks.correct_answer: It lets potential buyers consider purchasing the whole business or parts of it
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המנהל המיוחד יכול לבחון מכירת העסק או נכסיו, ולכן ייתכן שחלקים ממנו יינצלו.

tasks.prompt: Which offer included £12.5m up front but failed to complete in time?
options: Martin Property Group's offer
Pepco's offer
Zachert Private Equity's offer
Xyra group's offer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Xyra הציעה 12.5 מיליון ליש״ט מראש אך לא הספיקה להשלים עסקה.

tasks.prompt: How did Kelvin Blake describe the personal impact of Poundland's collapse?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את 25 שנות עבודתו, חששו שבגילו לא ימצא עבודה אחרת, אובדן ההכנסה והמשך העבודה עד שיורו לו לעזוב.
expected_points: Blake had worked for Poundland for 25 years.
At 62, he feared he would struggle to find another job.
He said his income was gone.
He expected to keep working until staff were told to leave.

tasks.prompt: Why did the timing of the funding restrictions make Poundland's position worse?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שההגבלות פגעו במימון הפעילות היומיומית ובחידוש המלאי דווקא לפני תקופת החגים החשובה למסחר.
expected_points: Stock could not be replenished at the necessary pace.
The problem occurred in the crucial run-up to the festive shopping period.

tasks.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences comparing Gordon Brothers' defence with its critics' claims.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את טענת החברה שהלוותה 85 מיליון ליש״ט ונכנסה כשלא היה מממן אחר, מול הטענות שהיא הגבילה כספים ועלולה להרוויח מפירוק.
expected_points: Gordon Brothers says it lent Poundland £85m over a year.
It says it took over when the retailer was struggling and no one else would finance it.
Critics say restricting access to funds worsened the crisis.
They also argue the owner may recover its loans and profit through insolvency.
Gordon Brothers denies claims that it intended to run the chain down.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the causes, immediate effects and possible next steps in Poundland's administration.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את כישלון עסקת ההצלה, מגבלות המימון, הסיכון ל־11 אלף משרות, המשך המסחר הזמני ואפשרויות המכירה.
expected_points: Rescue talks with several bidders failed.
Management said lost borrowing facilities and bank access left the company unable to remain solvent.
Stores and distribution centres are continuing to trade during administration.
Administrators may sell the business or its assets in whole or in part.
